questions.question: What is the purpose of the foreach loop in Perl?
questions.solution_html:
• ● for loop: Typically used for traditional, index-based numeric counters with explicit
  • initialization, condition, and re-evaluation expressions.
  • ● foreach loop: Designed to iterate seamlessly through every individual element of an array or
  • a list from beginning to end.
  • ● Aliasing: In a foreach loop, the loop control variable acts as a direct alias to the current
  • element; modifying it alters the original array element.
  • ● Interchangability: In Perl, the keywords for and foreach are technically interchangeable, but
  • stylistic conventions prefer choosing them based on readability.

questions.final_answer: stylistic conventions prefer choosing them based on readability.
